3. `iptables -P INPUT ACCEPT` - Sets default policy for INPUT chain to ACCEPT
4. `iptables -P FORWARD ACCEPT` - Sets default policy for FORWARD chain to ACCEPT
5. `iptables -P OUTPUT ACCEPT` - Sets default policy for OUTPUT chain to ACCEPT

This effectively resets your firewall to accept all traffic by default.

**Important**: This should only be run by someone with proper system administration knowledge, as it removes all firewall protection.
